content: If a DoIP message with payload type 0x0001 is not received on a configured DoIPUDPConnection, the message shall be discarded. Specification of Diagnostic over IP AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 29 of 129 Document ID 418 : AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticOverIP - AUTOSAR confidential -
If a DoIP message with payload type 0x0001 is not received on a configured DoIPUDPConnection, the message shall be discarded.
When the module receives a DoIP message with payload type 0x0001 on a connection different than a configured DoIPUdpConnection, the module shall discard the DoIP message.
